name: CAMSCR_BLEND_IN
meaning: enter via mode 9 (eased) instead of mode 7 (cut)

name: CAMSCR_CHAIN
meaning: when a script is already active, blend from the current pose (mode 10)

name: CAMSCR_BLEND_OUT_KEEP_ROT
meaning: mode 8 as with 0x2, but returns to the pre-script rotation instead of re-aiming
